title: ISD-Agent-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-based Instructional Design Agents
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating agents based on Instructional Systems Design (ISD) principles, specifically the ADDIE model. While it includes a standard section on 'Ethical Considerations' and one scenario example (AI Literacy) mentions 'ethical AI deployment,' the paper's core focus and evaluation framework are not centered on religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
